unresolved_added: The official problem statement is unavailable, so the task is reconstructed only from this paper.
Abstract claims about separation, robustness, and recommendation are internal previews without independent reproduction.
The 1331/1024 comparison illustrates accidental fit but is not a formal capacity or generalization bound.
Only message headers and topic labels are available; full text, timestamps, and provenance are absent.
The data have 318 unique pairs among 400 messages, limiting frequency estimation and temporal interpretation.
Topic 18 is discarded after ambiguous clustering without a frozen exclusion rule or sensitivity result.
The 98 raw count features are not standardized, and the artificial Cii column average changes the geometry.
K-means has random local optima, but enough runs is not quantified and no seed or convergence inventory is supplied.
The source says node 37 Elsie supports the identity decision but then labels node 27 Elsie unknown; this is a source typo.
Absence of Beth-to-Beth messages is weak evidence that nodes 14 and 38 are one person.
Cluster composition reuses the same representation and labels, so it is auxiliary co-validation rather than independent evidence.
The circuit's Kirchhoff/Laplacian linear system is omitted, preventing full reproduction of unknown voltages.
Alpha and beta are fixed at one while gamma, delta, and epsilon are set to zero without calibration or broad sensitivity analysis.
Generic biological transfer is speculative and adds training and physical assumptions absent from the crime data.
Sparse nodes connected only to suspicious topics can saturate at one volt even with very little traffic.
Voltage and guilt terminology overstates a proximity-based investigation-priority score.
Manager involvement is inferred partly from message volume and position, risking role prejudice and circular interpretation.
The 12-of-15 scenario overlap has no rank correlation, calibration, or held-out decision metric.
Leave-one-out reports six people always in the top ten but no aggregate error, rank-correlation, or uncertainty interval.
Repeated-name sensitivity merges identities under an assumption and still lacks external identity truth.
The 20 percent cutoff transfers 592 investigations from an extreme 3,200-employee case and is not calibrated to present costs.
The source-derived review count is 17 of 82 and ten additional workers; this is a resource proxy, not a guilt threshold.
The WordNet plus breadth-first semantic attempt failed, while LSI remains conditional on unavailable full text.
LSI inner product and sentiment conductances are proposed future repairs, not implemented evidence.
The recommendation omits uncertainty propagation, privacy, legal authority, false-positive cost, and stopping criteria.
Delores in the statement/recommendation conflicts with Dolores in result tables.
Appendix A assigns node 38 to both Paul and merged Beth while node 14 Beth disappears, conflicting with the main text.
No executable code, frozen data, software versions, seeds, runtime, or machine-readable outputs are supplied.
